g.text: - Source attribution does not prove activity or guilt

g.text: CARDINAL FORENSIC REPORTING PRINCIPLE [Bec20, Car20b, Bus22]:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #8c8c8c
font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Reports must maintain tripartite separation: physical observations, categorical conclusions, and empirical evidential strength;

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: neither 'identification' nor 'support' warrants claims of zero error, unique individuality, or criminal guilt.
